gaps.sentence: We had the walls ___ last month.
gaps.explanation: 'have something done' = arrange for it to be done: had the walls painted.

gaps.sentence: It's the first time I've ___ this dish.
gaps.explanation: 'It's the first time + present perfect': have eaten.

gaps.sentence: The children were excited ___ the trip.
He was sacked ___ repeatedly arriving late.
The new law comes ___ force next month.
gaps.explanation: 'come into force' = officially start to apply.

gaps.sentence: It was ___ dull a lecture that people walked out.
gaps.explanation: so + adjective (+a + noun) + that… — the alternative emphatic pattern.

gaps.sentence: I couldn't ___ laughing at his accent.
___ of my parents speaks French, so I translate for them.
gaps.explanation: 'Neither of' = not one and not the other (two people).
